tasks.title: Logout gate: test real session.lock hold, not file existence
tasks.notes: lib/blocks/logout_gate.py refuses whenever session.lock exists, but Minecraft leaves the file behind after leaving a world, so dryrun_reset refuses when logged out. Try a non-blocking POSIX lock (fcntl.lockf) and refuse only if held; add tests.
